tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The evaluation of Parameters 1 and 2 under AppendixN shall be carried out strictly in Accordance with the circular issued by the Chief Engineer, KBJNL, Canal Zone1 Bheemarayanagudi, vide Letter No. 1284 dated 01.10.2026.
During technical evaluation, if the employer finds that any certificates/information furnished is false, such bidders will be disqualified and barred from participation in the bid.

The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work, make themselves familiar with local situation about the availability of work men, etc before submission of bids. And also instructed to must refer the attached Tender notification and tender document.
Incomplete tender documents will be rejected.

The contractors/firm shall send the authorization letter for their representatives duly attesting their signature.4.The contractors/firm shall send the authorization letter for their representatives duly attesting their signature.
Typographical errors, if any will not be the ground for any claims by the Contractor.
The Bidder shall be responsible for successful performance of the contract.
The contractor/authorized signatory should attach his/her scanned signature to the Schedule-B before uploading and also submitting their tenders.
If any of the dates mentioned above happened to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good.

Conditional tenders are liable to be rejected. The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever at any point of time.
The estimate prepared is based on Karnataka PWD Common SR 2023-24, continued for 2024-2 And 2025-26
Corrigendum will be published in the KPPP site , corrections/modification if any.

Contractor should abide by the directions of Government towards recovery of 1% (or as modified by the Government from time to time) Cess from the contractor bill under the provisions of building and other constructions worker welfare cess Act 1996.
All conditions as per tender notification and bid document. For more details must refer bid Document.
The successful bidder should provide a manpower labours as per reservation criteria (Department of Personnel and Administrative reforms circular dated 20.05.2024)

The Bidder shall mandatorily upload, along with the bid at the time of submission of the tender, a valid and duly executed Authorization Letter/Power of Attorney authorizing the person, if any, proposed to represent the Bidder before the Tender Inviting Authority in connection with the particular tender.

No person claiming to represent the Bidder, including any Sub-Contractor, Agent, Consultant or Representative, shall be permitted to make any representation, correspondence, clarification, claim or attend any meeting on behalf of the Bidder unless specifically authorized in writing by the Bidder and such authorization is uploaded along with the bid within the stipulated time.

No oral, implied or subsequent authorization shall be entertained. Any representation made by an unauthorized person shall not be entertained by the Tender Inviting Authority and shall have no effect in the tender proceedings.

Failure to upload a valid authorization, wherever representation by an authorized person is proposed, shall be treated as non-compliance with this tender condition and shall be dealt with in accordance with the KTPP Act, KTPP Rules and the conditions of the tender.

The tender evaluation process shall remain strictly confidential until the tender is finally decided and the Award of Contract is notified. During the period of tender evaluation, no Bidder, Sub-Contractor, Agent, Representative, Consultant or any person claiming to act on behalf of a Bidder shall approach, visit or contact the Tender Inviting Authority, Tender Scrutiny Committee or any officer/official concerned with the tender evaluation for the purpose of seeking, influencing or obtaining information regarding the marks, evaluation status, comparative evaluation, documents or details of any other Bidder.

No person shall be permitted to seek or demand disclosure of the marks, evaluation details or other confidential information relating to any Bidder during the tender evaluation process. Any genuine clarification required by the Tender Inviting Authority shall be sought from the concerned Bidder only through the prescribed procurement process.

Any attempt by a Bidder, directly or through any Sub-Contractor, Agent, Representative or any other person, to establish unsolicited or unauthorised contact, exert influence, create pressure or interfere with the tender evaluation process shall be dealt with strictly in accordance with the provisions of the KTPP Act, KTPP Rules and the conditions of the tender, including disqualification wherever applicable.

No person claiming to be a Sub-Contractor or representative of any Bidder shall be entitled to demand or obtain the marks, evaluation details or confidential information of other Bidders from the office or any officer connected with the tender evaluation.

Further information can be had from the undersigned during office hours in the office of the Executive Engineer, KBJNL, JBC Division No.2, Bheemarayanagudi, Shahapur taluka, Dist Yadagiri and also through email id
Negative (-ve) Tenders are not acceptable.

Within 14 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance, the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in any FDR for an amount equivalent to 5 % of the Contract price ( The security deposit shall be released to contractor after 3 months of completion of the work and it shall be released after deducting if any dues with the department )1.1.7

The bidder has to quote only Service Fee (In LUMPSUM) which has to be quoted in Rupees ( rounding off to nearest two decimal places only so as to match the total amount or closest to the total amount.)

The Service Fee quoted by the Tenderer shall be inclusive of all relevant financial implications including inter-alia the nature of the Services to be delivered, location of the bidder, site(s) of the delivery of Services, terms of delivery, extant rules and regulations about taxes, duties, labor in India, overheads and incidental services for the whole services as described in Clause 1 of the ITT excluding GST.

The Service Fee quoted by the Tenderer shall remain firm and fixed for the duration of the Contract and shall not be subject to adjustment or any revision whatsoever (except any statutory variation in GST and Minimum Wage Rate as declared by Labour commissioner.

In the event that two or more Tenderers quote the same amount of Service Fee ( the Tie Tenderer), the Tenderer having the highest Technical Score shall be identified and declared as the Successful Tenderer. In the event the Technical Score of the Tie Tenderers happens to be same, the Tenderer having the highest Average Annual Turnover(in last 3 Financial years i.e 2025-26, 2024-25 & 2023-24) shall be identified and declared as the Successful Tenderer.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should have successfully provided man power services or similar services for any Central/State Govt./Semi Govt./PSU/reputed company established under the Companies Act, 1956 or 2013 during the last three Financial Years i.e Financial Years 2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26, preceding the last date for submission of Tenders such that the total/ combined man power deployed are not less than 25 (80% of the total estimated number of personnel required to be deployed by the successful tenderer under this Tender).( The certificate should be issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned Division / Equivalent officer ).Man Power supply work. Work done Certificate Issued by Executive Engineer and counter signed by SE, to be uploaded should have following information.

The Tenderer should hold a valid license issued by the Labour Department under Contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act, 1970. (i.e FORM VI issued by Assistant Labour Commissioner and Licensing authority under Contract labour act,1970).

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer shall have a positive Net Worth of not less than Rs.17.99 Lakhs,equivalent to at least 25% of the Amount Put to Tender, as on the last day of the most recently completed financial year preceding the last date for submission of tenders Financial Year 2026-27.The Tenderer shall upload a Net Worth Certificate issued by a Chartered Accountant (CA),duly containing a valid Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN), as documentary evidence in support of the above requirement.

The Tenderer should have minimum Average Annual Turnover of Rs.143.98 Lakhs (not less than two times the estimated amount put to tender).from the last three completed financial Years preceding the last date for submission of Tenders (i.e. Financial Year 2025-26, 2024-25, 2023-24.) (The Tenderer should upload the supporting document as Turnover certificate issued by Chartered Accountant with valid UDIN number).
